release_notes.en-US: Initial release: AI-powered download renaming via OpenRouter.
release_notes.zh-TW: 首次發布：依頁面內容由 OpenRouter 模型自動重新命名下載檔案。

version.approval_notes: Source code: https://github.com/Oliver0804/smart-download-renamer (MIT). The add-on intercepts downloads (downloads.onCreated), pauses them, collects page context (title/H1/meta/anchor text/excerpt) via a content script, calls the OpenRouter API (user-supplied key, https://openrouter.ai only) to suggest a filename, then cancels the original download and re-downloads it with the new name via downloads.download(). Fallbacks always restore the original download. No data is collected by the developer; page context goes only to the OpenRouter API the user configures.
